abilities.name: Frostwolf Resilience
abilities.description: Dealing damage with Abilities grants 1 stack of Frostwolf Resilience. At 5 stacks, Thrall is instantly healed for 240 Health.; trait

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Shock an enemy with lightning, dealing 170 damage. The lightning then bounces 3 times to nearby enemies, dealing 85 damage to each enemy hit.

fields.notes: Targets of secondary bounces are chosen at random from all units in range. Each unit can only be damaged once per cast.

abilities.name: Feral Spirit
abilities.description: Unleash a Feral Spirit that deals 153 damage to enemies in its path and Roots Heroes hit for 1 second. Each Hero hit increases the distance traveled by 25%.

fields.notes: Can still impact Invulnerable targets, giving Thrall stacks of Frostwolf Resilience, increasing the Ability's range, and benefiting Talents, though doing nothing to the target.

abilities.name: Windfury
abilities.description: Increase Thrall's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds. His next 3 Basic Attacks occur 100% faster and generate stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

fields.props: Attack Speed, Attack Modifier (resilience), Movement Speed

abilities.name: Sundering
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.; 70; 75; heroic

fields.notes: Sundering interrupts active displacements and momentarily removes collision on the targets.

abilities.name: Earthquake
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.; 100; 90; heroic

fields.notes: Only grants Frostwolf Resilience stacks from Heroes.

talents.name: Echo of the Elements
talents.description: Quest Kill Minions or Heroes within 1.5 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning. After killing 20 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20. Reward After killing 40 enemies, Chain Lightning bounces a second time and gains an extra charge. Reward After killing 100 enemies, each Chain Lightning bounce forks to an additional target.

fields.val1: 0.5 seconds. The Fork allows each bounce (including the initial) to start 2 instances of the next bounce in the chain instead of just 1 instance. The farthest target hit (this could use more testing) in a certain set of bounces won't be hit in the next set of bounces.

_raw_fields: Quest Kill Minions or Heroes within 1.5 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning. After killing 20 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20. Reward After killing 40 enemies, Chain Lightning bounces a second time and gains an extra charge. Reward After killing 100 enemies, each Chain Lightning bounce forks to an additional target.

talents.name: Crash Lightning
talents.description: Quest Hit at least 2 Heroes with a single use of Chain Lightning. Upon dying, lose 6 stacks. Gained rewards cannot be lost. After hitting multiple Heroes 15 times, Chain Lightning deals 270 additional damage on its bounces. Reward After hitting multiple Heroes 30 times, Chain Lightning deals 270 additional damage on its bounces, and prioritizes bouncing to enemy Heroes.

fields.notes: Bounce targets within the groups of Heroic or non-Heroic targets are still chosen at random.

_raw_fields: Quest Hit at least 2 Heroes with a single use of Chain Lightning. Upon dying, lose 6 stacks. Gained rewards cannot be lost. After hitting multiple Heroes 15 times, Chain Lightning deals 270 additional damage on its bounces. Reward After hitting multiple Heroes 30 times, Chain Lightning deals 270 additional damage on its bounces, and prioritizes bouncing to enemy Heroes.

talents.name: Maelstrom Weapon
talents.description: Quest Basic Attack Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active. After hitting 25 Heroes, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40% and Thrall's Basic Attacks deal 40 additional damage. Reward After hitting 55 Heroes, Thrall permanently gains 15% increased Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks gain an additional 75 damage. Reward After hitting 100 Heroes, Frostwolf Resilience healing restores 200% more Health.

fields.notes: Movement Speed bonuses do not stack.

talents.name: Feral Resilience
talents.description: Heroes damaged by Feral Spirit grant 4 stacks of Frostwolf Resilience and 2 stacks of Feral Resilience, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next incoming Hero Basic Attack. Stacks are consumed on the next cast of Feral Spirit.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Frostwolf Pack
talents.description: Quest Hit 6 Heroes with Feral Spirit. Progress is lost on death and when Thrall fails to hit a Hero. Reduce the cooldown and Mana cost of Feral Spirit by 50%.
_raw_fields: Quest Hit 6 Heroes with Feral Spirit. Progress is lost on death and when Thrall fails to hit a Hero. Reduce the cooldown and Mana cost of Feral Spirit by 50%.

talents.name: Mana Tide
talents.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Rolling Thunder
talents.description: For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.

talents.name: Ancestral Wrath
talents.description: Cooldown 1 Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt. Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

fields.props: Damage over Time, Lifesteal, Percent damage
fields.notes: Does not generate Frostwolf Resilience stacks. Starts with 0 stacks.

talents.name: Elemental Assault
talents.description: After using a Basic or Heroic Ability, Thrall's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds deals 45% more damage.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other damage modifiers affecting Thrall's Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Grace Of Air
talents.description: Windfury attacks grant twice as many stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.
_raw_fields: Windfury attacks grant twice as many stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

talents.name: Frostwolf's Grace
talents.description: cooldown 15 Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing Health.

fields.notes: Triggering Frostwolf Resilience this way still benefits from all Talents and Abilities affecting it. Activating does not affect the current amount of Resilience stacks. Bonus healing stacks additively with healing dealt modifiers.

talents.name: Spirit Shield
talents.description: Cooldown 45 / 0.75 Every 45 seconds, gain 70 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 4 seconds. Triggering Frostwolf Resilience reduces this cooldown by 10 seconds. Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Tempest Fury
talents.description: The final strike of Windfury hits 3 times for 75% normal damage. These strikes do not provide quest progress.

fields.notes: Each additional hit generates Frostwolf Resilience stacks. Only the first hit of the three part series benefits from Follow Through 's damage bonus. Stacks additively with other damage modifiers affecting Thrall's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: The final strike of Windfury hits 3 times for 75% normal damage. These strikes do not provide quest progress.

talents.name: Thunderstorm
talents.description: Chain Lightning Slows targets by 8% for 2 seconds. Repeatable Quest Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%. Reward While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 30%. Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

fields.notes: Slow only affects the primary target (and only if it is a Hero). Stacks additively with other damage modifiers affecting Chain Lightning 's damage.

talents.name: Alpha Wolf
talents.description: For 3 seconds after a Hero is hit by Feral Spirit, Thrall's Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 3% of the target's maximum Health as damage. Passive Increase the duration of Feral Spirit's Root to 1.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Bonus damage is dealt in a separate instance and does not generate Frostwolf Resilience stacks.

talents.name: Worldbreaker
talents.description: Lower the cooldown of Sundering by 40 seconds. After Sundering impacts, it leaves behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: 1) Consists of two rows of 4 overlapping circles with 2.5 radius. The "impassable rift" can be cancelled earlier by pressing the heroic button again.

talents.description: Allies within the Earthquake area gain a Shield equal to 15% of their maximum Health each pulse. This shield lasts 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Calculated from the target's maximum Health.
